note: Code derivation: POSITIONAL - data/znidarsic_2021_work_family_balance.py assigns CS01..CS09 to df.iloc[:,18:27] of S1 Data (the deposit has no item codes; every header is the full English stem). Header diff: shipped item_text = the S1 Data header at each position with leading whitespace stripped, 9/9; the S1 File docx 'Co-worker support' table lists the same 9 strings in the same order. Mapping checked (verify script): each live item's resp 1..5 count vector matches exactly one of the 18 support columns (leader cols 9-17 + co-worker cols 18-26), always the co-worker column at the script's position, 45/45 cells (e.g. CS01 11/18/83/89/46, CS06 56/32/45/62/52); CS05/CS07 share mean 3.595 but differ in counts. The leader block asks the same behaviours (item 1 reads 'Switched schedules...' there vs 'Helped me to switch schedules...' here) and does not match. Transcribed literally, including the source's grammar ('Did not held', 'Did not showed') and spacing '( hours, overtime hours, vacation )'; item 3 'Takes into account...' and item 1 carry no final period, as in the source. Options: Methods 2.1 gives the leader-support scale as '1 (never) to 5 (very often)'; the co-worker block is the same nine items re-asked about co-workers and no separate anchors are stated for it, and the Results paraphrase both blocks as '1 meant never and 5 meant always'. Shipped 1='never', 5='very often' from the Instruments section (lower-case as printed); 2-4 unlabelled, left blank. Instructions left blank: the paper only paraphrases the task ('rate ... how frequent an individual leader uses certain supportive behaviors'); no literal instruction or item stem (e.g. who 'helped me') is published, so the referent 'co-workers' lives in the instrument name only. Language: administered language not stated in the paper; inferred Slovenian (online survey of employees of Slovenian enterprises, export sheet named 'anketa225317', the Slovenian 1KA survey-platform export pattern; items 'adapted accordingly'). No Slovenian wording in the deposit or supplements (S1 Data xlsx and S1 File docx contain no non-ASCII letters beyond a curly apostrophe; only S1 and S2 are attached). Fallback: English in base fields, language=Slovenian, _translated empty, translation_source=study_supplied (the study's own English headers). Sample: S1 Data has 247 rows while the paper reports 343 respondents; S1 File item means (e.g. CS01 3.73, CS02 3.80) are from the larger sample and do not reproduce from the deposit (3.57, 3.67), so they were not used for verification. Rights: instrument_rights_register.csv 'CLASS-closed-silent-adaptation' row (verdict ship, Ben 2026-09-23, irw#2381 R16) names this table; applied, not re-derived.
